conversations.why: Keyset paged on updated_at with the id as the tiebreaker, so a chat written while the sidebar is open cannot move the window.

projects.why: Keyset paged on the same helpers as conversations.

library.why: The artifact index is paged by a sync cursor rather than a page number, because a device pulls what changed since it last looked.

notifications.why: Bounded to the unread window a reader can act on, so the route returns one page and no cursor.

audit.why: Paged by offset today; the compliance reader asks for a page number and the export path streams the whole range.

members.why: A workspace roster is bounded by the seat count, so the route returns it whole.

usage.why: Paged by offset today over an append-only ledger.

search.why: Ranked results are capped at one page because relevance past the cap is not meaningful.

offsetPagination.why: An operator page over a queue that changes under the reader, so page two can miss a job that was drained and repeat one that was enqueued.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The credit ledger is append-only, so a row inserted above the window shifts every later row down and page two repeats what page one showed.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The message window inside one conversation is offset paged, so a message deleted above the window silently drops one from the next page.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The cursor path is the one the surface uses; the offset parameter stays for clients that still send it and is documented as such in the route.
offsetPagination.fix: Drop the offset parameter once no shipped client sends it.

offsetPagination.why: The memory list is offset paged and ordered by pinned then updated_at, so pinning a memory while the list is open shifts every later row.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: Keyset paged; the offset parameter stays for clients that still send it and is documented as such in the route.
offsetPagination.fix: Drop the offset parameter once no shipped client sends it.

offsetPagination.why: Run history is offset paged over rows a running schedule keeps appending.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The task list is offset paged and a schedule created while the reader pages drops one from the next page.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: Account activity is offset paged over an append-only trail.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The compliance reader pages by offset, so an event written during the read shifts the window and the export can miss a row.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: An operator page over a ticket queue that changes under the reader: a ticket resolved above the window drops one nobody sees on the next page, and one raised above it repeats one already shown.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts on (created_at, id) and return an opaque cursor instead of an offset.

offsetPagination.why: Trigger event history is offset paged over rows the ingest keeps appending.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

offsetPagination.why: The trigger list is offset paged.
offsetPagination.fix: Read the page with keysetSql and buildPage from apps/web/lib/identity/pagination.ts and return an opaque cursor instead of a row count.

unpagedReads.why: The artifact index is pulled by a sync cursor the device holds rather than by a page number, so the limit bounds one pull and the cursor is the position.
Ranked results are capped at one page because relevance past the cap is not meaningful; the limit bounds the cap rather than naming a page.
Help results are capped at one page for the same reason.
An operator triage queue bounded by the open report count; the limit caps one screen.
An operator dashboard bounded by the recent-signal window; the limit caps one screen.
An operator view of live break-glass grants, bounded by the number that can be open at once.
The connector call log is capped at a recent window; the limit caps one screen.
A reader's own reports, bounded by how many one account produces.
The public API returns a bounded run window; the limit caps one response.
One run's events, bounded by the run.

gap.why: The Pagination primitive is exported from @agiworkforce/ui and no surface renders it, so every list that loads more rows draws its own control and none of them announce the same thing to a screen reader.
gap.fix: Render the shared primitive from the conversation, project and audit lists, or delete it and standardise on the affordance those lists actually use.
